fields.title: Column
fields.description: Select one numeric column whose values will be tested against the specified bounds.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Use lower bound
fields.description: If enabled, only rows whose column value satisfies the lower bound condition are directed to the first output port.

fields.title: Lower bound value
fields.description: The lower bound value. Only rows whose column value satisfies the lower bound condition are directed to the first output port.

fields.title: Lower bound operator
fields.description: Defines how the lower bound is applied to the column value.

fields.title: Use upper bound
fields.description: If enabled, only rows whose column value satisfies the upper bound condition are directed to the first output port.

fields.title: Upper bound value
fields.description: The upper bound value. Only rows whose column value satisfies the upper bound condition are directed to the first output port.

fields.title: Upper bound operator
fields.description: Defines how the upper bound is applied to the column value.
